dialogues.speaker: Beryna
dialogues.text: If I could make some delicious bread, I'm sure it'd lift everyone's spirits. But with things the way they are, it's not that easy...

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I'm trying to recreate a kind of bread my mother used to make for me when I was little. It looked a bit like a mushroom.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: From what I remember, you first cook down mushrooms and berries into a thick filling, then wrap it in freshly kneaded dough and bake everything together.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: The most important part is using flour made from freshly harvested wheat. That's what gives the bread its taste of warmth.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I came here hoping to gather some wheat, but it looks like no one's had time to tend the fields lately. Now, there are all sorts of odd little creatures wandering around.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: If Mr. Valdis were here, I'm sure he could deal with them. But I'm really not good at that kind of thing...

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: So, um... could you help me gather some wheat? I only need a little. In return, I can teach you how to make warm mushroom bread. Please?

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Hey, don't leave yet. Could you lend me a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Beryna
dialogues.text: There are all sorts of odd little creatures in the wheat field. Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Beryna
dialogues.text: Wonderful, thank you! With this fresh wheat, I can finally make warm, comforting bread again.

dialogues.speaker: Beryna
dialogues.text: Now, as promised, I'll teach you how to make Mushroom Phantasm. Make sure you remember this...
